title: Additional Card Member FAQs
evidence: Own purchases and total balance are visible; other account access requires separate manager authority.
limitations: Rechecked I01. Not a Household privacy rule or repayment-policy recommendation.

title: Terms and Conditions for Account Managers
scope: US; modified 2023-12-01; role tables pp.1–5, duration p.6
evidence: Full and Limited roles have different actions and channels; Full is consumer/business, Limited also corporate.
limitations: Rechecked I02. Table text and search-rendered marks read; no claim of visual table verification. Removal wording differs from C03.

title: Add or remove Account Managers
evidence: The online removal answer says only the Basic Card Member can remove a manager.
limitations: Narrow FAQ wording differs from the more detailed C02 Full/Limited table.

title: Employee Cards
evidence: Employee limits, category alerts, pause/resume and activity are separate controls.
limitations: Rechecked I03. Product/category exceptions remain; no universal corporate-role matrix.

title: Employee Card Spending Limits terms
scope: US employee-card limit terms; undated one-page document
evidence: Limit edits can exclude earlier period spending; refresh can lag, and credits do not restore this limit.
limitations: Descriptive Amex behavior, deliberately not Etail's required retained-usage rule; not an immutable promise across products.

title: @ Work Access Center
evidence: Designated MPAs manage PA scope. Cancellation stops portal/phone access immediately; Reporting may take 10–14 days.
limitations: No private screens inspected. Scheduled-report delivery is expressly a separate exit consideration.

title: Enroll and manage Program Administrator access
scope: US page with non-US local approvals; copyright 2021, revision unknown
evidence: New access requests require enrollment and authorized signatures, including local signatories for relevant non-US markets.
limitations: Not a general consumer invitation process or evidence all countries share identical permissions.

title: Cancel an employee's Corporate Card
evidence: PA cancellation requires a reason and returns tracking; the FAQ describes immediate individual-card cancellation.
limitations: Cancelling a card does not establish closure of company obligations or all user access.

title: Global Apply for Card: administrator FAQ
scope: US corporate with market variants; undated
evidence: PA exit requires updating application notifications and maintaining authorized coverage.
limitations: Rechecked I05. Existing approval-flow findings remain in the earlier study; Quick Send and post-approval vary by market.

title: Global Apply for Card: applicant FAQ
evidence: The published application has expiry and save/resume rules, plus reminders.
limitations: Rechecked I06. Exact Amex expiry rules are not Etail defaults; completed acceptance was not exercised.

title: Set up your Corporate Card
evidence: Enrolled holders can view statements, pay bills, submit expenses, receive alerts and dispute charges.
limitations: Own-card servicing does not grant program administration or establish who is liable.

title: Merchant Site Terms of Use
scope: US merchant portal; observed footer 10/31/25; sections 4–6
evidence: Email/Merchant/Bank user roles and Limited/Flexible access levels are different dimensions.
limitations: Rechecked M26. Bank User names a portal role, not a bank or unconditional payout authority.

title: Edit Bank Information
evidence: Selected merchant credit/debit destinations are changed after an identity check.
limitations: Rechecked M20. The guide does not establish a complete role matrix or payout-release entitlement.

title: Online contact information and alerts
evidence: Contact changes and alert preferences are profile-specific; sensitive contact edits require verification.
limitations: Rechecked M24. A User Role edit label is not evidence of unrestricted permission escalation.

title: Logging in and enrolling in Disputes
evidence: Online dispute enrollment changes the notification route from mailed letters to online cases; email alerts are optional.
limitations: Enrollment does not establish who may accept a claim, issue a refund or release funds.

title: Freeze my Card FAQ
evidence: Freeze includes exceptions and automatic unfreeze after seven days.
limitations: Rechecked I08; Etail intentionally uses its existing persistent hierarchical freeze rule.

title: Managing deceased Card Member accounts
scope: US personal/small business, with separate corporate contacts; undated
evidence: Anyone may report a death; discussion, cancellation and possible takeover require different authority/eligibility.
limitations: No automatic inheritance. Amex responsibility and takeover terms are not imported into Etail.

title: Life events: assisting someone and bereavement
evidence: Third-party disclosure, power-of-attorney support and bereavement are separate assistance routes.
limitations: UK evidence only; it does not establish a US incapacity checklist or automatic caretaker authority.

title: How Amex Corporate helps organizations navigate growing financial complexity
scope: US corporate; published 2026-07-24; liability section and footnotes
evidence: Corporate and combined liability options differ and require approval.
limitations: Product description, not an Etail liability agreement; administrator title does not resolve responsibility.

title: Beginner's guide to Additional Card Members
scope: US consumer, young additional holders; undated
evidence: The guide describes holder payments, own-history access and spending alerts.
limitations: Educational card-account example, not Etail guardian-funded balances or an independent minor repayment obligation.

title: Merchant registration: I'll do this later
evidence: Deferred verification leaves a limited registration experience.
limitations: This onboarding limitation is distinct from the formal Limited/Flexible access levels in C12.

title: Dispute a charge: @ Work resource guide
evidence: Pending monitoring, posted-charge disputes, status and withdrawal are distinct stages.
limitations: Rechecked I15. It does not establish every PA's dispute authority; no Amex payment-relief term imported.

title: Blue Cash Preferred Additional Card Member benefits
scope: US Blue Cash Preferred additional holder; undated
evidence: The page offers additional holders dispute assistance and fraud/payment/purchase notifications.
limitations: Specific card product; it does not establish every additional holder's authority to withdraw disputes or change accounts.
